title: Finalize 2025 catch and update 2026 catch
description: Waiting for the October 1 catch query. Separate final 2025 removals, reported 2026 catch at extraction, and the estimated remainder of 2026.
completion_criteria: Record source, extraction date, units, retained/discarded and CDQ treatment; reconcile final 2025 catch; document the 2026 year-end estimate and its completion method.

title: Update BTS 2025–2026 indices and covariance
description: Obtain the delivered BTS index estimates and uncertainty for 2025 and 2026, including revisions to earlier observations.
completion_criteria: Verify actual survey years and coverage; retain estimates, covariance or supplied uncertainty, method version, and comparison with the previous series. Preserve the absent 2020 BTS.

title: Update ATS 2026 index and age-1 series
description: Obtain the 2026 acoustic-trawl survey index and separate age-1 estimate, with their uncertainty and survey coverage.
completion_criteria: Validate units, delivered uncertainty, revision, and actual survey years. Preserve the corrected ATS 2020 age-1 treatment and keep the missing placeholder outside fitting.

title: Update AVO index through 2026
description: Obtain observations through 2026 where surveyed and document revisions to the acoustic vessel-of-opportunity series.
completion_criteria: Record processing revision, observation years, coverage and uncertainty; compare revised historical values and document the approved uncertainty treatment.

title: Update BTS age compositions through 2026
description: Obtain the delivered BTS age compositions through 2026 and identify changes in expansion or age-estimation methods.
completion_criteria: Retain actual survey years, age range, sample sizes, expansion method, age-reading provenance and uncertainty; validate composition totals and years against the index inputs.

title: Receive final ATS 2026 age compositions
description: Waiting for the final 2026 ATS age-composition delivery. Keep the delivered survey-age series separate from the age-1 index.
completion_criteria: Confirm final delivery and age-reading method; validate compositions, age range, sample sizes and uncertainty. Preserve zero composition weight for the absent ATS 2020 age sample.

title: Update fishery ages for 2024 and 2025
description: Obtain the completed 2024 and 2025 fishery age compositions and associated sampling information.
completion_criteria: Record fish and haul counts, strata, expansion, age-reading method, uncertainty and revision; validate the terminal composition year as 2025 and preserve source age-method labels.

title: Update biological and weight-at-age schedules
description: Assemble fishery and survey weights at age and check the maturity, spawning-weight and natural-mortality inputs used for the assessment.
completion_criteria: Compare each schedule with the baseline; document sources, units, years, missing-year assumptions, and the rationale for any change.

title: Document ageing error and composition weights
description: Reconcile ageing-error treatment, sampling counts and likelihood sample sizes for fishery, BTS and ATS compositions.
completion_criteria: Archive matrices and age methods; distinguish sampled fish, starting sample sizes and final likelihood weights; document all adjustments and preserve zero ATS 2020 composition weight.

title: Validate and freeze matched model inputs
description: Prepare matched, dated input sets for primary Model 26.0 (Rceattle) and comparison Model 23.0.
completion_criteria: Check source revisions, observation schedules, dimensions, units, sums, missingness, ageing error and weights; record changes, checksums and the selected input versions before fitting.
